opening.comment: The agent did not clearly give their own name and the company name; "titwell" is an unclear rendering of the company name and no agent name is stated.

verification.quote: Agent: Name and order number postcode.
verification.comment: The agent asked for name and order number or postcode, and the caller gave a name and order number 804257 before any order data was shared, so this step was met.

understanding.quote: Agent: My never arrived. been 72 working days and i absolutely furiou, this is the second time.
understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue of a non-arrived parcel, but the call summary shows the caller's stated 72 working days conflicts with the 13 working days read back, and the agent did not clarify this.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Agent: Right. i opened uh lost parcel It closes within 9 working and then we send uh replacement within 3 working days.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The policy says the investigation only opens after 10 working days without delivery and closes within 5 working days, so the agent's 9-day closure timeline is wrong and the 13-day transit case was handled inconsistently with the stated 72-day claim.

process_compliance.quote: Agent: um putting you uh on hold.
process_compliance.comment: The agent placed the caller on hold without asking permission first and did not thank the caller on return, so the hold step was not followed.

communication.quote: Agent: My never arrived. been 72 working days and i absolutely furiou, this is the second time.
communication.comment: The caller said they were furious and this is the second time, but the agent never acknowledged the frustration and the agent's replies were curt.

closing.quote: Agent: You'll get an female when the investigation closes. Is the there anything less I thank you can help with?
closing.comment: The agent gave a next step, though unclearly worded, and asked if there was anything else, but the closing was rushed and the agent's goodbye used the wrong company name.
